When did you first feel this way—the moment when “missing” became noticeable even though nothing obvious had changed around you?
You mentioned on March 22nd that he surprised you with dinner—that was when you felt seen after so long not being. Now it feels different?

Regardless of any underlying cause, new or recurring chest pain requires evaluation from a healthcare provider—ideally starting with a primary care physician or emergency department depending on severity—to rule out cardiac issues first. They can then assess whether mental health factors are contributing once medical causes have been excluded.

You’re wondering whether finishing things is part of your nature — which suggests there are moments when that’s not obvious from how you experience yourself. Is there a particular domain (work, creative projects, relationships) where the pattern feels clearest either way?
